content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often restrict access for creators in Kenya, limiting your ability to sell ebooks effectively. COREMERCH leverages blockchain technology to eliminate these barriers. By utilizing cryptocurrencies for payments, you ensure that transactions are secure, fast, and low-cost. For instance, USDT on the Tron network settles in under 60 seconds for a fee of less than $0.10. This approach empowers you to accept payments from anywhere in the world, driving international sales without the constraints of conventional banking.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your ebook store, you will need a few essential tools. First, choose a hosting solution from GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages; these are free and reliable. Next, incorporate backend logic with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle your store’s operations. You will also need to create a database using Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Finally, set up your payment gateway with NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. With these components, you have the foundation to deploy your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your hosting and database set up, it’s time to integrate your payment and delivery systems. Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept a variety of cryptocurrencies, allowing your customers to pay with USDT, Bitcoin, or others. Set up automatic webhook notifications to trigger product delivery once payments are confirmed on-chain. You can store your ebooks on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for easy access and delivery. This robust pipeline ensures that your customers receive their purchases instantly after payment.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographical barriers for creators.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With everything in place, it’s time to launch your store. Test your system by processing a small transaction to ensure that payments are being handled correctly and that order notifications are functioning. Monitor your store’s performance and be ready to address any potential issues. Once you confirm that everything operates smoothly, promote your ebook store through social media and other channels to attract buyers. This proactive approach helps you reach a wider audience and start generating sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your ebook store, consider how you can scale your business. You can add more digital products to your catalog, utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates, and enhance your marketing efforts. Explore various cryptocurrencies to accept, allowing more flexibility for payment options. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to refine your offerings and improve user experience. This strategic growth will drive more revenue and establish your brand in the digital marketplace.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Hosting on Cloudflare Pages ensures reliability and speed for your store.

By utilizing our resources, you can build a robust digital store and process payments via cryptocurrency. Check our offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Start by selecting GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your site. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. Create an order database with Supabase or Google Sheets. Set up NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Store your ebooks on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless delivery. Test your store with a small transaction before going live. Promote your store through social media to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the best payment methods for online sales in Nigeria?

In Nigeria, you can use cryptocurrency payment gateways like NOWPayments, which allow you to accept various cryptocurrencies without the need for a traditional bank account. This method facilitates international sales and offers low transaction fees.
How do I set up my ebook delivery system?

You can set up your ebook delivery system by storing your files on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. After a purchase, configure your payment processor to send an automated delivery link to the customer, ensuring instant access to their ebook.
Can I sell ebooks without a website?

Yes, you can sell ebooks without a traditional website by using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to host your store. This allows you to create a functional online store without incurring high costs.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?

Consider accepting popular cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, USDT, and Ethereum. These currencies have widespread adoption and allow you to cater to a global audience while keeping transaction fees low.
Is it possible to scale my ebook business later?

Absolutely. Once your initial setup is running smoothly, you can scale your ebook business by adding more products, enhancing your marketing strategy, and utilizing additional tools from the Complete Builder Kit to increase sales.
